column1: # For the POLYC generations the frozen contract is BYTE_EQUALITY:
# G1 == G2, G1 == G3, G2 == G3.  The three PolyC generations
# produce byte-identical objects, which is exactly why the provenance
# witness (and not the object bytes) is what detects a substitution.
# For G0 against each PolyC generation the comparison is SEMANTIC:
# G0 is the legacy C reference, so byte-identity is NOT expected and
# NOT required.  (G0's object is the whole legacy ast.c; the PolyC
# objects are the single component function.)
